checks.explanation: A decade-long forecast for robotic 'hard takeoff' with a ~3-year central estimate; far too early to assess.

As of August 2026, reporting confirms Agility Robotics' Digit V5 is launching (reportedly targeted for December 2026) with barrier-free human-robot collaboration as its headline feature, consistent with the prediction, but the 2026 launch window has not fully elapsed and 'first' is not yet independently verified against competitors.
